kpis.signal: High margin for a medical device manufacturer.

kpis.explanation_en: Capital Expenditures — investments in property, plant and equipment.

kpis.explanation_en: Headcount — total number of employees at period end.
kpis.signal: Slight decline after finalization of post-acquisition integrations.
Significant provision reflecting international tax complexity.

kpis.explanation_en: Measures BD's essential medical products revenue, showing the health of its core business activity.

Measures annual growth of adjusted earnings per share, showing if company becomes more profitable for each shareholder year-over-year.
Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability

kpis.explanation_en: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.signal: Shareholder returns growing, dividend policy supportive
